# Learning companion conventions

Follow AGENTS.md. Keep the src-layout package lightweight and offline-capable.
Validate curriculum identifiers, prerequisites, and prerequisite cycles.
Use parameterized SQLite queries and explicit transactions.
Record progress only for available lessons and make completion learner-controlled.
Provide objectives, prerequisites, progressive examples, outputs, exercises,
explained solutions, misconceptions, and revision questions in every complete lesson.
Do not implement a purported sandbox with subprocess timeouts: those are not isolation.
Label model-generated material unverified if an optional model adapter is added later.
